research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.eviden: A loose metal flew to your hand.
A fixed anchor dragged you towards it.
An anchor under your feet lifted you.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.1: When you burn iron, who moves: you or the metal? Compare something light with something that cannot move.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.2: Pull a loose coin or ingot into your hand; then pull on a fixed iron block.
research.mistbrn.anchor_principle.hint.3: Push with steel on a metal under your feet: if it cannot give way, you rise.
